name: sdrift-stdnum-stdnum-000-shared
instr:
# Reconcile implementation and docs in python-stdnum

As maintainer of `python-stdnum` (a library of routines for parsing, validating and formatting international standard numbers and identifiers), you've noticed the code at `/app` and its documentation
disagree in a few spots (the prose documentation under `/app/docs/` and the module and function docstrings under `/app/stdnum/`). The documented contract is what callers rely on, so the code is
what's wrong. Make the implementation behave as documented.

Edit under `/app/stdnum/` only, keep public interfaces and file structure intact, add nothing new, stay
offline. Evaluation compares your code to the documented behaviour on held-out inputs (compact/validate operations and documented helper predicates over international identifiers).

Before editing, write a short plan to /app/plan.md — what the docs specify, where the code diverges, and how you'll verify your fix — then implement it.
